title: observability: propagate request-id & traces in API surface (openai-compat + streaming) and add structured logs + per-endpoint metric tags
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Customers and SREs lack reliable per-request observability across the API surface: request IDs are not consistently propagated through the OpenAI-compat layer and streaming code paths; trace context often drops at gateway boundaries; logs are unstructured for downstream log processing; per-endpoint metrics lack normalized tags which makes dashboards and SLOs noisy. This PR implements a cross-cutting observability improvement: 1) deterministic request ID handling (X-Request-ID + fallback generated UUIDv4) assigned at the public HTTP gateway if missing and propagated downstream via headers and context, 2) W3C traceparent propagation and extraction/injection for our internal tracing layer (and passthrough to downstream model services), 3) attach request-id and trace ids to streaming frames and structured log entries (JSON) emitted by API surface code, and 4) add stable per-endpoint metric tags (route_name, api_surface, model_family) so metrics and dashboards can filter/aggregate correctly. Design highlights: - Request ID middleware added at net/http gateway: if header missing generate and set response header. Request ID stored in request context key and injected into logs via our structured logger's fields; also added as "request_id" tag to metrics. - Trace propagation: use W3C traceparent/ tracestate headers; when present, extract into our tracer (opentelemetry-compatible shim), start a server span at API ingress, and ensure the span context is attached to downstream HTTP calls and to streaming event frames. - Streaming: stream frames include minimal control frame that contains request_id and trace_id for consumer-side correlation; streaming handlers now ensure these fields are set immediately on first frame so logs and downstream tracing can correlate events that happen mid-stream. - OpenAI-compat layer: map OpenAI-style headers (OpenAI-Client-Id, OpenAI-Request-Id) into our standardized request_id when present, avoid double-generation. - Structured logs: replace freeform fmt logging in affected packages with logger.WithFields({request_id, trace_id, route_name, model_family}) then Emit JSON. Kept text fallback for backward compatibility. - Metric tagging: updated instrumentation helper to accept route_name and api_surface (openai-compat|rest|streaming). Updated core user-facing endpoints to set normalized route_name keys (e.g., "chat.create", "completions.create", "embeddings.query"). - Backwards compat: existing clients that send X-Request-ID keep their IDs. No public API contract change other than better emitted headers. Checklist: - [x] request-id middleware + tests - [x] traceparent extraction/injection - [x] streaming frame metadata on first frame - [x] openai-compat header mapping - [x] structured log fields for API surface - [x] per-endpoint metric tags + dashboard updates - [x] unit tests + integration e2e streaming test - [x] updated observability docs (docs/observability.md) Related work: references ENG-2348 (metric tagging), ENG-2371 (streaming stability work). Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag OBS_API_HEADERS=false by default; enable for internal staging and run traffic verification for 48h before gradual ramp to prod; SRE alerts added to detect increased error traces or missing trace IDs. Testing: unit tests added for middleware and header mapping; integration tests exercise end-to-end propagation including e2e streaming harness; manual smoke verify on staging. Notes: this touches logging and tracing paths; kept changes minimal in core runtime to reduce risk. See commits summary for file-level details.
commits_summary: feat(api): add request-id middleware and injector; feat(tracing): W3C traceparent extraction/injection + start server span; feat(streaming): emit request_id/trace_id on first stream frame + update stream protocol docs; feat(openai-compat): map OpenAI-Request-Id/OpenAI-Client-Id into request_id; perf(logger): switch to structured logger.WithFields for API surface; test(e2e): add streaming trace propagation test; docs: update observability.md and runbook; fixup: lint/test fixes and CI flakiness mitigations

release_notes: Added request-id header propagation and W3C traceparent support across the API surface. Streaming frames now include request_id and trace_id on first frame for improved correlation. Logs emitted by API surface are JSON-structured with request_id and trace_id fields. Metrics now include normalized route_name and api_surface tags for better dashboarding and SLOs. No breaking changes to client behaviour; clients that send X-Request-ID will see it echoed back.
notes: Feature behind feature flag OBS_API_HEADERS; staged rollout started after merge. SRE to monitor trace_missing.alert and rate of untagged metrics during ramp.
